# TheKnack

> TheKnack makes apps for iPhone and iPad. 32 of them are on the App Store today, and all are listed below with one plain sentence and an App Store link. 3 have a full page on this site with key facts, what is included with the download, privacy and answers to common questions.

## App pages on this site

- [Ethiopian Bible: Lost Books](https://theknackapps.com/ethiopian-bible/): An offline English reader for the King James Bible and the Book of Enoch, with Jubilees, Jasher, Meqabyan and the KJV Apocrypha in the Full Library, and a map of the 81-book Ethiopian canon.
- [NoBuy: No Spend Day Tracker](https://theknackapps.com/no-buy/): Tracks no-spend days with one question each night, and helps in the moment with an urge timer and a waiting list.
- [FanWake: Flash & Light Alarm](https://theknackapps.com/fanwake/): An alarm clock whose alarm screen flashes between two colors you pick, with an optional blinking flashlight and, on iPhone, vibration on every flash.

## All apps on the App Store

### Faith and reading

- Ethiopian Bible: Lost Books: An offline English reader for the King James Bible and the Book of Enoch, with Jubilees, Jasher, Meqabyan and the KJV Apocrypha in the Full Library, and a map of the 81-book Ethiopian canon. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6793595535
- Septuagint: Apostles’ Bible: Brenton’s 1851 English translation of the Septuagint, the Greek Old Testament, with a map of where the New Testament quotes it. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6799791328

### Health and fitness

- Migora: Migraine Tracker: A private migraine and headache diary that shows the barometric pressure around your attacks. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6789600102
- Pressora: Barometric Pressure: Reads the air pressure with your iPhone’s own sensor and lines it up with a 48-hour pressure forecast. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6789722462
- Lumifaste: Fasting Stage Timer: A fasting timer that shows the time and your current fasting stage on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760971357
- AquaFaste — Hydration Score: A water tracker that sets a daily goal from your weight and activity level and gives you a Hydration Score from 0 to 100. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760975661
- Restbell: Sets, Rounds & Rest: A timer for the rest between lifting sets and for the work and rest blocks of interval training. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6801274064
- Nurova: Baby & Contraction: One app for pregnancy week by week, a contraction timer, and a newborn’s feeds and sleep. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6789838880

### Habits and journaling

- Micro Journal: One Line a Day: A journal for one sentence a day, with an optional mood tag on each entry. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760717868
- Tendril Habits: A habit tracker with a garden that grows as you keep your habits. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760949423
- Selfora: Daily Affirmations: A feed of first-person “I am” affirmations, grouped by theme. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782375179
- Horizora: The Day Stack: Shows the time until or since a date as a stack of years, months, weeks or days, in a Home Screen widget. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6801275379

### Money

- NoBuy: No Spend Day Tracker: Tracks no-spend days with one question each night, and helps in the moment with an urge timer and a waiting list. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760716822
- ThingCost - Daily Cost Tracker: Shows the daily cost of the things you own: what you paid, divided by how long you have owned it. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760629048
- Cadora: Gift Readiness: Keeps gift ideas for the people in your life and shows how ready you are for each birthday, anniversary and occasion. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6789179574

### Everyday tools

- dB Meter - Sound Level Meter: A sound level meter that shows the live level in decibels with the minimum, average and maximum, and keeps a history of your measurements. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760597296
- FanWake: Flash & Light Alarm: An alarm clock whose alarm screen flashes between two colors you pick, with an optional blinking flashlight and, on iPhone, vibration on every flash. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760596100
- Caliper: Level, Ruler & Angle: A bubble level, an on-screen ruler, an angle finder and a quick sound check in one app. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6794116622
- Ratora: A unit converter for 14 unit families that shows the answer as you type. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6801280293
- did I? - Daily Check Reminder: Confirms everyday checks, such as locking the door, with one tap that records the time and, with location on, the place. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760625773
- Shrinkora: Video Compressor: Compresses a video on your iPhone so it fits the size limit of where you are sending it. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6794055483
- Tidora: Clean Photos by Month: Clears the camera roll one month at a time: swipe to keep or delete, then confirm. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782422062
- WrenchLog: Car Maintenance Log: A car maintenance log with a VIN decoder and safety recall checks against the NHTSA database. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760980170

### Family and pets

- Dayrow: Visual Schedule: A visual schedule for children: a morning, a bedtime or a whole day laid out as a row of picture cards. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6794449826
- Vettie: Pet Vaccine Reminder: A pet vaccination record that shows what is due. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760741400

### Hobby logs

- Citora: City Travel Log: A map of every city you have visited, with more than 69,000 cities searchable offline. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6798396285
- Saponora: Soap Making Log: A soap-making log with lye math and a cure tracker that says when bars are ready from their weight. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6798702739
- Ovenspring: Sourdough Log: A sourdough starter log that measures each rise from photos of the jar that you mark. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6798660827
- Coneglow: Pottery Log & Glaze: A pottery notebook that follows each piece from throwing to firing, with the glazes you used. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6798674813
- Feltside: Vinyl Record Log: A log of your vinyl records: what you have, their condition, what you have played and how many hours are on your stylus. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6800852846
- Flockora: Backyard Chickens: A backyard chicken log for daily egg counts, hens, health notes and purchases. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6793725764
- Gambora: Keeps the chess openings you play as a map of lines and shows which ones are due for review. https://apps.apple.com/app/id6800003716
